title: Network Participation Agreements — Catch-up on the Post-decision Withholding Ceiling
content:
**Catch-up rule.** Recovery of a decided overpayment under the **Network Participation Agreements** resumes with the first claim payment run after the decision. When that run comes well after the decision, the ceiling on the withholding catches up. The post-decision catch-up of the post-decision withholding ceiling is set by the days from the decision's resolved date to the run's date:

- more than 14 days adds 4 ceiling points for every whole 7 days;
- more than 7 and at most 14 days adds a flat 4 ceiling points;
- 7 days or fewer adds nothing.

## Terms

- **The decision** is the agreement's most recent dispute decision, read for its resolved date.
- **The run** is the agreement's most recent claim payment remittance, read for its date.
- **Ties.** Where two entries or decisions share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's records is taken.
- **Counting.** The resolved date is not counted; the run's date is.
- **Top band.** In the top band the points are 4 for each whole 7 days in all the days from the decision to the run. Days left over beyond the last whole 7 add nothing.

## Table of days and points (hypothetical runs)

| Days from decision to run | Ceiling points added |
|---|---|
| 7 | Nothing |
| 8 | 4 |
| 14 | 4 |
| 15 | 8 (two whole 7-day periods) |
| 21 | 12 |
| 27 | 12 |
| 28 | 16 |
